name: Sati Poly Plast Ltd.
summary: Sati Poly Plast Ltd. is an India-based company primarily engaged in the manufacturing and sale of flexible packaging materials. The company provides a comprehensive range of packaging solutions, including roll form packaging, pouch form packaging, vacuum packaging, lidding films, shrink care, co-extruded films, and 3D/5D pouch packaging. These products cater to diverse industries such as food and beverage, e-commerce, hygiene and personal care, household, automotive, engineering, agriculture, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, and consumer durables. The company offers specialized packaging for snacks, chips, oils, biscuits, confectionery, groceries, powdered products, tea, coffee, beverages, dairy products, frozen foods, pet care, and retort food, encompassing both food and non-food applications. While the company experienced a fire accident at its corporate office in February 2025, business operations are being managed through another manufacturing plant in Greater Noida and job work by a promoter group company, with plans to restart the affected plant upon receiving insurance claims.
